pieces.title: One door in, one gate out
pieces.caption: Four branches funnel through one door onto main. At the far end stands a gate with the Sentry's avatar on it, and a dashed arrow out to GitHub that only Loudon's word draws. *What is real and what is a choice:* A drawing of the page's own summary sentence. Nothing is measured. *Leaking in:* Sentry at the gate; Worktree Practice in the branches.
